title: Luxury container with private pool and great views
description: Discover Luxe Container, a stylish retreat in Aguada, just 15–20 minutes from Rincón’s famous beaches. This cozy container apartment features modern amenities, elegant furnishings, and well-placed windows framing lush views. Relax by the climatized pool or dine alfresco in the serene outdoor space. Close to local restaurants and vibrant coastal activities, it’s the perfect blend of comfort, style, and adventure for an unforgettable Puerto Rican getaway.The spaceLuxe Container: Your Gateway to Relaxation and AdventureWelcome to a one-of-a-kind luxury retreat in the charming town of Aguada and just a short 15–20-minute drive from the world-renowned beaches of Rincón. This unique container apartment combines sleek industrial design with upscale comfort, offering you an unforgettable stay in Puerto Rico’s paradise.Located in a tranquil spot, the apartment features a cozy and elegant interior with strategically placed windows that allow natural light to brighten the space while offering glimpses of nature's surroundings. The modern layout includes a fully equipped kitchen and luxurious furnishings that ensure every detail of your stay is effortless and enjoyable.Step outside to your private oasis, where a climatized pool awaits. Whether you’re starting your morning with a swim or relaxing under the stars, this space is designed for ultimate serenity. A cozy terrace offers the ideal spot for outside dining or savoring your morning coffee with the sounds of nature around you.The apartment is conveniently located close to a variety of local restaurants, giving you easy access to authentic Puerto Rican cuisine and lively entertainment. Whether you’re exploring the nearby beaches of Rincón, indulging in water sports, or simply savoring the vibrant coastal lifestyle, everything you need is just minutes away.Discover the perfect blend of luxury, location, and leisure at Luxe Container—your dream getaway awaits.Guest accessYou will have acces to all the facilities within the gated area.Other things to noteJust a heads-up❗️❗️❗️ — the property is powered exclusively by LUMA, our local electric service provider. In the rare case of a power outage or service interruption, please know that it's beyond our control. Thanks for your understanding!
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, infinity

title: Rincón Home for 16+ | 10 Min Beach & Downtown
description: Hillside retreat in Rincón for groups of up to 20 guests.El Danuview Suites includes four fully equipped units with a total of 8 bedrooms, 8 beds, 2 sofa beds, and 5 bathrooms, offering comfort, privacy, and space to gather. Two units feature private balconies with scenic mountain and ocean views in the distance. The property runs on solar energy and includes a shared 600-gallon water tank for added comfort during service interruptions.The spaceWelcome to El Danuview Suites – Your Hilltop Hideaway in RincónEl Danuview Suites is a private hillside retreat made up of four individually styled suites—La Ola (Unit 1), La Palma (Unit 2), Coral (Unit 3), and La Montaña (Unit 4)—offering accommodations for up to 20 guests. Each suite is thoughtfully designed with boho-chic décor, inspired by the vibrant spirit of Rincón, blending nature, calm, and comfort.🏡 The Suites:🌊 La Ola – Unit 1 (For the surf lover)Perfect for families or groups, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit offers three queen beds, a full kitchen, smart TV, Wi-Fi, and a spacious living and dining area. The master bedroom has a private ensuite. This unit also features access to a private balcony with mountain and ocean views.2 assigned parking spots and access to the private balcony.Guests must supervise children at all times when using the balcony.🌴 La Palma – Unit 2 (For the Island Dreamer)A cozy and comfortable 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit with three queen beds. The full bathroom is conveniently located in a central space near the kitchen and living area. Like La Ola, it includes a full kitchen, smart TV, Wi-Fi, and stylish décor.2 assigned parking spots and access to the private balcony.Guests must supervise children at all times when using the balcony.🌅 Coral – Unit 3 (For the Sunset Chaser)Our most compact yet cozy suite. This 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit has a queen bed and a sofa bed in the living room, sleeping up to 4 guests. Includes a full kitchen, dining space, smart TV, and Wi-Fi.1 assigned parking spot.No balcony access, but ideal for couples or small families.⛰️ La Montaña – Unit 4 (For the Mountain Wanderer)A spacious 1-bedroom suite with mountain views from both the kitchen and bedroom. Features a queen bed, a queen-size sofa bed, a full bathroom, smart TV, Wi-Fi, and a full kitchen and dining area.1 assigned parking spot.No private balcony but filled with natural light and fresh breezes.🔑 About the Property:Total accommodations: 8 queen size beds + 2 queen size sofa beds, 5 Full - bathroomsSelf-check-in via secure lockboxFree Wi-Fi and smart TVs in every unit (streaming only – no cable)Free parking: Up to 6 vehicles when all four units are bookedSolar generator for backup power (please use responsibly)Water tank for outages (please use responsibly)Air conditioners must not go below 68°F to prevent malfunctionGuests must not touch or manipulate any of the power or water equipment.👪 Why Stay Here?El Danuview is perfect for group travel—you can stay together but still enjoy privacy across separate units. Whether you’re hosting a family reunion, a friends’ retreat, or a group getaway, our property gives you both togetherness and personal space.Located in Barrio Cruces, Rincón, we’re a short drive from world-class beaches, local dining, and the vibrant Rincón plaza. Note that the mountain location features narrow, curved roads, and the property is not walkable—a car is necessary.Guest accessCheck-in is self-service through a secure lockbox located just outside the units. You are welcome to check in anytime after 3:00 PM, unless an early check-in has been previously arranged and approved. The lockbox code will be sent closer to your arrival time, and it changes after each guest to ensure security.Other things to noteBefore You Book – What to Know 🏞️El Danuview suites sits on a lush Rincón hillside, just 10 minutes from downtown and the beach! But to get this view, you’ll travel up scenic, curvy roads—some steep, narrow, and one-lane in parts. It’s part of the adventure, so we highly recommend having a car.Also, while the area is full of natural beauty and laid-back vibes, it can get lively—especially on weekends or during holidays. You might hear music, parties, or other celebrations. It’s part of the colorful, vibrant culture that makes Puerto Rico so alive. If you’re seeking silence 24/7, this might not be the perfect fit—but if you love energy, sunshine, and mountain views, you’ll feel right at home!Traveling with a Group? Discover Danuview Suites! ✨While you’re viewing this specific unit, don’t miss the opportunity to book multiple suites together—ideal for family vacations, group getaways, retreats, or celebrations.Here are our tailored group options:• 8 guests in 2 units: La Montaña + Coral• 12 guests in 2 units: La Palma + La Ola• 16 guests in 3 units: La Palma + La Ola + La Montaña• 20 guests when booking all 4 suites: La Palma, La Ola, La Montaña, and CoralEach suite is fully equipped and thoughtfully designed—offering comfort, privacy, and easy access to pools, beach-style amenities, and shared spaces. You’ll enjoy staying close while still having the room to unwind.💬 Send us a message to check availability for your group—we’re happy to help create the perfect stay.Together is better at Danuview Suites.

description: 2 Bed/2 Bath Casita located in a small-gated community with a shared resident’s pool. This Casita is just 200-steps away from a fantastic calm family beach. Restaurants, dive shops and activities like snorkeling, kayaking, paddle boarding and horseback riding are right next to your rental.The spaceYour Casita is fully air-conditioned, has high-speed wireless Internet access and is equipped to make your stay in Rincon flawless. It features two bedrooms; the master bedroom has one queen bed, full bathroom and walk-in closet. The second bedroom has a full bed with plenty of closet space and drawers for your beachwear. A second full bathroom is located across the hallway from the second bedroom. In the living area you can unwind after a busy day at the beach. Enjoy the sofa while watching your favorite TV show. The living room couch is a sofa bed, if extra sleeping space is needed.The fully equipped kitchen has stainless steel appliances, pots and pans, toaster, cups, utensils, toaster, coffee maker as well as microwave, and other comforts of any home. A small dining area is set for 4 people and additional seating for 2 is available in the kitchen counter area. For your added convenience, the unit offers a laundry area with a full washer and dryer in the kitchen room.The outdoor living space is designed for your enjoyment with family and friends. Jump into the resident’s pool that is just in front of the Casita or BBQ the afternoon away feeling accomplished after surfing your first Rincon wave. Whatever you do just don’t forget the sunset in Rincon is just an easy walk from your newfound paradise.Guest accessGuests will have access to the entire Casita.
